data.text:
ONE OF THE WORST NIGHTCLUB FIRES

#OnThisDay in 1996, a fire broke out in Ozone Disco in Quezon City, killing 162 people, mostly youth, while 95 others were hurt in the tragedy.

The numerous deaths were attributed to the lack of fire safety measures inside the building, as well as the improper installation of the exit door which swung inward rather than outward.
